paper_title: AI Scientists Fail Without Strong Implementation Capability
caption: Analysis of AI Scientist publications on arXiv. The upper panel displays the average number of citations up to now, categorized by containing implementation details. The lower panel shows the growth in the total number of these papers with the same categorization.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates how a measured “Quantity” changes across three time periods for two categories labeled “Without Implementation” and “With Implementation.” The x-axis is categorical with three tick labels—“Fall ’24,” “Winter ’24,” and “Spring ’25”—spaced evenly from left to right. The y-axis is labeled “Quantity,” uses a linear scale, and spans from 0 to 24 with regularly spaced tick marks every 3 units (0, 3, 6, …, 24). One line represents “Without Implementation” as a teal solid line with circular markers (white-edged), with values annotated at each point; it increases from 10 at Fall ’24 to 15 at Winter ’24 and to 21 at Spring ’25, and the area beneath the line is shaded in a semi-transparent teal. The other line represents “With Implementation” as an orange solid line with square markers (white-edged), also annotated; it rises from 2 at Fall ’24 to 7 at Winter ’24 and to 13 at Spring ’25, with a semi-transparent orange shading under the line. A legend in the upper-left identifies the two series.
